definition.en: Alfred Wegener’s idea, first presented in 1912, that the continents move. Plate tectonics later replaced it: the plates include the ocean floor too.
definition.zh: 魏格纳 1912 年首次提出的想法：大陆会移动。后来的板块构造取代了它：板块也包括洋底。

definition.en: The theory that Earth’s outer shell is split into plates that move relative to each other, usually a few centimetres a year. It was worked out in papers from 1965 to 1968.
definition.zh: 地球外壳分成多块板块、彼此相对移动的理论，通常每年几厘米。它在 1965 至 1968 年的一批论文中形成。

definition.en: A time when most of the continents are joined into one block of land.
definition.zh: 大部分大陆连成一整块陆地的状态。

definition.en: The supercontinent that began to assemble about 320 million years ago and began to break apart about 200 million years ago.
definition.zh: 约 3.2 亿年前开始拼合、约 2 亿年前开始分裂的超大陆。

definition.en: The large southern continent made of today’s South America, Africa, Madagascar, India, Antarctica and Australia; mostly assembled by about 550 million years ago.
definition.zh: 由今天的南美洲、非洲、马达加斯加、印度、南极洲和澳大利亚组成的南方大陆，约 5.5 亿年前大体拼成。

definition.en: Past time counted in millions of years; 300 Ma means 300 million years ago.
definition.zh: 以百万年为单位表示过去的时间；300 Ma 表示 3 亿年前。

definition.en: A model that works out where plates were in the past from evidence such as rock magnetism and the ocean floor. It is a calculation, not a photograph.
definition.zh: 根据岩石磁性、洋底等证据推算板块过去位置的模型。它是计算结果，不是照片。

definition.en: Any movement of a plate over the sphere can be described as a turn about an axis through Earth’s centre; the rotation pole is where that axis meets the surface.
definition.zh: 板块在球面上的任何移动都可以看作绕一根穿过地心的轴转动；这根轴与地表的交点就是旋转极。

definition.en: Parallel scratches cut into bedrock by stones carried in the base of a glacier.
definition.zh: 冰川底部夹带的石块在基岩上刮出的平行划痕。

definition.en: A long underwater mountain range where new ocean floor forms.
definition.zh: 绵延的海底山脉，新的洋底在这里生成。

definition.en: New ocean floor forming at a ridge and moving away on both sides. Harry Hess described it in 1962; Robert Dietz coined the term in 1961.
definition.zh: 新洋底在洋脊生成并向两侧移开。赫斯在 1962 年描述了它；迪茨在 1961 年提出这个名称。

definition.en: A swap of Earth’s magnetic north and south. The most recent one was about 773,000 years ago.
definition.zh: 地球磁场南北方向互换。最近一次约在 77.3 万年前。

definition.en: Bands of stronger and weaker magnetism in the ocean floor that run parallel to a ridge and mirror each other on both sides.
definition.zh: 洋底磁性强弱相间的条带，与洋脊平行，并在两侧互为镜像。

definition.en: Satellite positioning. A fixed station measured for years shows how its ground moves, by millimetres to centimetres a year.
definition.zh: 用卫星信号测定位置。长期测量的固定站能显示脚下地面每年移动几毫米到几厘米。

definition.en: Land of the Sunda Shelf that was above water when sea level was lower, about 120 m lower at the coldest time of the last ice age. It is about sea level, not plate movement.
definition.zh: 海平面较低时露出水面的巽他陆架陆地；末次冰期最冷时海平面约低 120 米。它和海平面有关，与板块移动无关。
